**Requirement analysis:**

1. **Full professors** — Distinguish from "Assistant Professor". The `role` values: "Professor of X" vs "Assistant Professor of X". Full professors are those whose role starts with "Professor" (not "Assistant Professor"). In the data: Orfeas Menis, Pepe Attanasio, Aristotle Tympas, John Smith, Marie Dubois are "Professor of..."; Athanasios Voulodimos and Stefan Mueller are "Assistant Professor of...".

2. **Works in at least one department of a university located in an EU country.** EU member states as of 2025-08-16. Countries in data: CH (Switzerland - not EU), ES (Spain - EU), PT (Portugal - EU), GR (Greece - EU), FR (France - EU), US (not EU), DE (Germany - EU).

3. **Among all departments they work in, at least one has more than 10 students currently enrolled in any classes taught in that department.** "Currently enrolled" — a student is currently enrolled if they have not yet graduated as of 2025-08-16 (i.e., no graduation date, or graduation date after reference date).

g = Graph()

q = """
PREFIX uni: <http://university.org/ontology/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT ?dept (COUNT(DISTINCT ?student) AS ?n) WHERE {
  ?course uni:isTaughtIn ?dept .
  ?student uni:isEnrolledIn ?course .
  ?student uni:role "Student" .
  OPTIONAL { ?student uni:hasGraduationDate ?grad }
  FILTER(!BOUND(?grad) || ?grad > "2025-08-16"^^xsd:date)
} GROUP BY ?dept ORDER BY DESC(?n)
"""
for row in g.query(q):
    print(row.dept, int(row.n))
